# PM Study Circle

> > Comprehensive PMP exam preparation resource offering study guides, ebooks, question banks, and formula guides aligned with PMBOK Guide 6th and 7th editions.

PM Study Circle, created by Gabriella Kecskemeti, provides project management professionals with structured study materials, practice questions, and certification training resources for the PMP exam. The site covers both traditional PMBOK methodologies and Agile practices to help candidates pass their certification.

## Key Topics

- PMP Exam Preparation
- PMBOK Guide 7th Edition
- PMBOK Guide 6th Edition
- Agile Practice Guide
- PMP Question Bank
- PMP Formula Guide
- Project Management Certification
- Contact Hours
- Study Resources and Ebooks
- Gabriella Kecskemeti
- Certification Training
- PMP Exam Study Materials
